operations.body: https://github.com/dgoings/workbook/pull/138: main process owns the collapsed flag beside the theme, re-lays out the board views, then tells the shell; chevron plus Cmd+B / Ctrl+B via before-input-event on every web contents; rail menu button expands first. Subagent-driven with per-task review and an adversarial whole-branch review; one fix wave. Verified by hand on macOS (screenshots attached): rail, both toggle paths, board repositioning, state round-trip. Not exercised: rail menu button, Windows/Linux. Residuals in the PR body; follow-up task WB-01M2XAM2DV36G2ATSPSNMY52CJ.
